dedupe_keys.name: data and model code assessing the implications of hydrogen blending on the european energy system towards 2050

description: Jonathan Hanto and colleagues publish data and model code for their study of hydrogen blending in the European energy system towards 2050. The native title and description identify the study, while the three file descriptors distinguish model, input-data and results archives in RAR format. The deposit therefore represents one study-specific input and output bundle. It supplies material for energy-system planning involving gas and hydrogen infrastructure. Zenodo provides free access under CC BY 4.0. The metadata does not enumerate countries, blending ratios, scenario assumptions, numerical variables or simulation time steps. The year 2050 is the stated study horizon, not an observation date. The related GENeSYS-MOD family record supplies model context. The archives were not opened, and neither reproducibility nor numerical results have been checked.
